_comment: Blueprint (蓝图 / 工程蓝图) theme — deep blueprint-blue ground with a pale white-blue coordinate grid, white wireframe-dominant buildings with faint blue fill. Engineering/BIM aesthetic — the 'clean technical' look done right (replaces the flat minimal style). Reuses gridGround.glsl (same shader asset as cyber) but with a blueprint palette (deep blue ground + pale grid lines). Same key names as the cyber theme so the generator derives colors the same way; only the values change. To retheme, edit values here only.

category._comment: Legend category → color. building = pale blue-white wireframe fill, garage = cyan accent.

building._comment: v1.4 楼栋楼层/房间层次（§4）。蓝图：roomShade 极小（线框主导、弱填充），dividerColor 用淡白青作楼层虚线。

shaders._comment: Blueprint reuses gridGround.glsl (same asset as cyber) but with a blueprint palette: deep blue ground + pale white-blue coordinate grid. u_gridColor is the pale grid line color.

environment._comment: v1.2 园区环境配色（§10）。蓝图气质：深蓝单色调，绿植压成蓝灰抽象块以维持工程图氛围；标线/发光取淡白青。

garageEntrance._comment: v1.4 地下车库入口标记（§5）。半金字塔三角门 + 描边，P 牌高对比（深蓝图底 + 淡白青字）。

surfaceParking._comment: v1.4 地面车位（§10）。长方形车位，深蓝铺装 + 淡白青描边，深底亮字 P。旧 frame/sign 已废弃保留兼容。

poi._comment: v1.3 兴趣点（§11）类型→颜色。蓝图：在深蓝底上高可读的亮色，克制不发光（或极弱自发光勾边）。
